channel.title: Violations Watch: Ukraine
channel.description: New incidents reported in Ukraine. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Russian strike on a five-storey apartment building in Sloviansk on 22 Nov kills 10, including a child, after a six-day search, Ukraine's State Emergency Service says (Ukrinform, LB.ua)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Russian armed forces (per Ukraine's State Emergency Service). Reported casualties: 10 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Figures from Ukraine's State Emergency Service only; injuries not reported. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2708
